data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Time Zone Converter, then holidays, then a mail compose with the right To and Subject and a matching Body), but it adds a recipient parameter that was fixed in the true workflow, says "ahead" where the true body uses a neutral offset, ends with "Send or discard" instead of the required discard, and handles the holiday country less clearly. These are minor gaps, and the steps are concrete enough to automate.
